title: Tofu Tagine with Umami Sauce
description: A creative Italian twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, featuring a rich umami sauce and tender tofu.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: extra-firm, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant and lightly golden, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the umami sauce, Chinese five-spice powder, and lemon juice.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and stir to coat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 10-12 minutes or until the sauce has thickened and the tofu is coated.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot over rice or with crusty bread.
